line-height: 24px !important; color: rgb(113, 113, 122) !important; }.ad-settings-resource-list-head .ad-btn { background: rgb(9, 9, 11) !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; border-color: rgb(9, 9, 11) !important; }.ad-settings-resource-row, .ad-settings-member-row { padding-left: 24px !important; padding-right: 24px !important; }.ad-settings-feature-card { display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; }.ad-settings-feature-card .tx b { display: block !important; margin: 0px 0px 8px !important; font-size: 16px !important; line-height: 24px !important; font-weight: 600 !important; letter-spacing: -0.01em !important;
